newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks seen cautious ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks seen cautious ahead of results.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks are seen sticking to a groove on Thursday as investors await interim corporate results, brokers said.
"No one wants to be the first to buy before the results come out," said Sarinda Unambooowe of John Keells Stock Brokers.
The results to June were expected to be good, due to low interest rates and uninterrupted power supply, brokers said.
On Wednesday the all share index closed 1.9 points down at 820 on turnover of 70.5 million rupees.
